DEWARIM_MAP.Title: Map Painter
DEWARIM_MAP.AddRoot: Add a folder to the palette
DEWARIM_MAP.AddRootHint: A folder in user data (assets/props, assets/textures/dungeon) or of Foundry (icons/environment).
DEWARIM_MAP.RemoveRoot: Remove this folder from the palette
DEWARIM_MAP.Missing: This folder does not exist yet. Put images there with the File Commander or by uploading.
DEWARIM_MAP.PickHint: Pick an image, then click or drag on the canvas.
DEWARIM_MAP.PaintHint: Pick a texture, then paint grid cells on the canvas.
DEWARIM_MAP.RepeatHint: How many grid cells one copy of the texture covers before it repeats.
DEWARIM_MAP.PaintKeys: Drag paints · Ctrl+drag fills a rectangle · Alt+drag erases
DEWARIM_MAP.PaintSquareOnly: The brush paints square grids only.
DEWARIM_MAP.BlocksHint: This image becomes walls: stamped tiles get walls around them, painted cells along the outline. Remembered per image for the world.
